environment.windows: native Windows, Python 3.x via py launcher

wsl_focused.command: wsl bash -lc 'PYTHONUTF8=1 PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest tests.core.test_cli tests.packaging.test_posix_distribution tests.packaging.test_fresh_install_linux tests.packaging.test_package_contract tests.rpp.test_integrations tests.evals.test_summarization_eval tests.integrations.test_multiai tests.memory.test_compile_flush tests.memory.test_session_scripts tests.packaging.test_br019_posix_platform'

wsl_full.command: wsl bash -lc 'PYTHONUTF8=1 PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .'

verified: Real WSL POSIX detached child runs in its own session and is terminated cleanly.
Real POSIX claim file is owner-only (0600) and has a single winner.
Real POSIX symlink escape is rejected by path_within_vault; contained paths still pass.
WSL /mnt/<drive>/Users/<user> conversion and windows_user_root/external temp mapping.
Real source CLI hook returns each provider contract on WSL: claude/gemini hookSpecificOutput, cursor additional_context, antigravity injectSteps, opencode additionalContext.
Source lifecycle: registration and all text-summary providers (claude/codex/antigravity/gemini) write one daily entry on WSL.
POSIX installation repair/uninstall contracts run for real under WSL (tests.packaging.test_posix_install).
Windows native full suite remains green after the POSIX test-contract changes.
Native Obsidian shortcut is Windows-only; off Windows it is a typed BAD_REQUEST instead of a crash.
Subprocess tests use an absolute source PYTHONPATH independent of the child cwd.
limitations: macOS was not verified on hardware; only the existing platform simulations cover it.
No Linux frozen build was produced. dist/ currently contains a Windows artifact; the Linux wheel contract test skipped because the 'build' package is absent in WSL.
cursor-agent is deliberately fail-closed in text mode and is not a session summarizer; this is an existing security contract, not a platform failure.
Obsidian .url shortcut registration remains Windows-native only.
logs_note: *.log files are gitignored; hashes identify the local verification runs.
